lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: Unit 312 confirms it. Whatever I stamped on Lina's appeal — the housing register already knew.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: Orvin's note was scheduled for incineration. Harrel signed the death and the destruction eighteen minutes apart.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Clerk 1147-F. Your exterior movement has exceeded standard duration.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: I need to get out of this building before they schedule mine.
